data.name: The Death of Rebirth®
data.detailed_description:
THE DEATH OF REBIRTH                                                                                                                                       

Humanity no longer sends heroes.

The condemned are deployed instead.

Sent beyond civilization into hostile procedural worlds consumed by fanaticism, decay, and endless war, convicted P.O.W operatives are forced into near-suicidal missions under the authority of a brutal religious regime. Survival is not expected. Redemption must be earned.

Complete dangerous objectives across dead landscapes filled with ancient ruins, hostile factions, automated defenses, and overwhelming enemy forces. Scavenge resources, recover lost technology, and augment your body and equipment to survive long enough to extract.

Every deployment pushes deeper into worlds abandoned long ago — places where failed expeditions, forgotten civilizations, and endless conflict have left entire regions corrupted beyond recognition.

Fight through oppressive environments shaped by procedural generation, where each operation presents new terrain, dangers, and opportunities for survival.

FEATURES                                                                                                                                                                

PROCEDURAL HOSTILE WORLDS

Explore large-scale dead landscapes filled with ruined structures, decayed battlegrounds, industrial remnants, hostile patrols, and unpredictable combat zones.

HORDE COMBAT

Survive against overwhelming enemy forces guarding critical objectives, fortified positions, and ancient territory lost beyond civilization.

BODY & GEAR AUGMENTATION

Recover resources and technology to improve survivability through equipment upgrades, combat enhancements, and physical augmentation.

HIGH-RISK OBJECTIVES

Deploy into dangerous operations where survival is never guaranteed. Complete objectives and extract before being overwhelmed.

DARK RELIGIOUS SCI-FI SETTING

Experience a grim world shaped by fanaticism, punishment, sacrifice, and endless warfare.

RETRO-INSPIRED ATMOSPHERE

A stylized visual presentation blending low-poly environments, oppressive lighting, fog-filled landscapes, and harsh industrial decay.

REDEMPTION DEMANDS SACRIFICE                                                                                                                      

Those sent into the dead worlds are not expected to return.

Only to serve.

ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT                                                                                                                                         

The Death Of Rebirth is currently in active development. Certain gameplay systems, visuals, mechanics, and planned content may change throughout production as development continues.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB or Radeon R7 360, 2 GB or Intel Arc A310, 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game includes graphics settings to aid lower end devices. FSR Included, choosing between Dx11 or Dx12, optimized around 11 more stable on UE5
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660, 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX Vega 56, 8 GB or Intel Arc A580, 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB MB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game includes graphics settings to aid lower end devices. FSR Included, choosing between Dx11 or Dx12, optimized around 11 more stable on UE5

content_descriptors.notes: The game has a realistic atmosphere, where dismemberment is a possibility when avoiding monsters. Other Clone brethren in this criminal inhumane experiment might die along your side or kill you possible through means of force. Over all you and the other clones can die through various means.
